$doc: Polish pass on the I5b sheets: every clip re-run, its job id, first frame (scripts/art/pixellab/polish/first.mjs: the stored input frame of the clip it replaces) and description word for word. subject_description and initial_pose are the class's I5b ones (PROMPTS_ART › 19); view high top-down, direction = the facing. Verdicts: ASSET_LOG › Polish.

jobs.description: seen from behind, dying in battle: his strength suddenly gives out, he rocks back on his heels with his chest and head thrown back and his arms flung out, and topples over backwards towards the viewer's lower right, falling heavily onto his back on the ground behind him and lying still face up; he falls backwards, never forwards, his head ends nearest the viewer; the kopis falls from his hand and lies beside him; his body stays clean, no wounds, no red, no blood at all, no effects
jobs.verdict: Promoted: rocks back and falls on his back, face up, head to the viewer (a1 pitched forward face down)

jobs.description: seen from behind, his back and cloak to the viewer in every frame, he takes his fighting guard in place: he grips the haft with both hands and raises the falx forward so its blade stands up ahead of him towards the upper right at head height, the inner edge towards the enemy; the falx keeps its own shape in every frame: a short iron blade that bends sharply forward at the top into a deep hook like a beak, the hooked point clearly drawn and turned towards the enemy, never a straight or gently curved sword; knees bent, the left foot a little forward; he keeps facing away towards the upper right, he does not turn round; one falx only, both hands on the haft at the end; no shield, no effects
jobs.verdict: Rejected: the hook overdone into a shepherd's crook, a bright grey blade held upright, no low guard

jobs.description: seen from behind, steady marching walk in place away from the viewer towards the upper left, long natural strides, his back to the viewer in every frame; his right arm swings out a little away from his body at his right side with the leather sling hanging from his right fist, the two cords and the pouch swinging clear of his body on the viewer's right in every frame; the short cloak hangs only down the middle of his back and never covers his right arm or the sling; the left arm swings naturally; one sling only; no shield, no effects
jobs.verdict: Better: the sling swings clear on the right in f3-f12 (10 of 16; a2 7 of 16); still behind the cloak f0-f2, f13-f15

jobs.description: seen from behind, his back and cloak to the viewer in every frame, he takes his fighting guard in place: he crouches into a low guard, knees bent and the left foot a little forward, both hands on the wooden haft, and swings the falx forward and down so its curved iron blade reaches ahead of him towards the upper right at head height, the edge towards the enemy; the falx keeps the shape it has at rest in every frame: a long blade curving forward with its point turned in at the tip like a sickle, dark iron, the same size as at rest; he keeps facing away towards the upper right, he does not turn round; one falx only, both hands on the haft; no shield, no effects
jobs.verdict: Promoted (f7 the new NE guard): a low guard, the blade hooked in at the tip like the base's falx, forward at the enemy

jobs.description: seen from behind, running in place at a steady heavy jog away from the viewer towards the upper left, knees lifting, leaning a little forward, his back to the viewer in every frame; his right arm pumps out a little away from his body at his right side with the leather sling hanging from his right fist, the two cords and the pouch swinging clear of his body on the viewer's right in every frame; the short cloak streams back only down the middle of his back and never covers his right arm or the sling; the left arm pumping; one sling only; no shield, no effects
jobs.verdict: Promoted: the sling swings clear on his right in every frame (a1 hid it behind the cloak f1-f4)

jobs.description: seen from behind, dying in battle: his strength suddenly gives out, he rocks back on his heels with his chest and head thrown back and his arms flung out, and topples over backwards towards the viewer's lower left, falling heavily onto his back on the ground behind him and lying still face up; he falls backwards, never forwards, his head ends nearest the viewer; the kopis falls from his hand and lies beside him; his body stays clean, no wounds, no red, no blood at all, no effects
jobs.verdict: Promoted: rocks back with the arms flung out from f1 and falls on his back (a1 hunched forward f3-f4 before falling)

jobs.description: seen from behind, his back and cloak to the viewer in every frame, standing in place in a tense fighting stance, knees bent, the weight shifting slowly from foot to foot, breathing; both hands stay on the haft and the curved falx blade stays held forward towards the upper right in every frame, swaying a little; the falx keeps its shape in every frame: the curved iron blade with its point turned in at the tip like a sickle; he keeps facing away towards the upper right, he does not turn round; one falx only; no shield, no effects
jobs.verdict: Promoted: the hooked blade held forward in every frame

jobs.description: seen from behind, his back and cloak to the viewer in every frame, charging forward at a heavy run in place away from the viewer towards the upper right, leaning into it, knees driving, both hands on the haft and the curved falx blade held forward and low ahead of him the way he faces in every frame, the whole falx clearly visible in every frame, never hidden; the falx keeps its shape in every frame: the curved iron blade with its point turned in at the tip like a sickle; he never turns round; one falx only; the cloak streams back; no shield, no effects
jobs.verdict: Promoted: the hooked blade forward and low, visible in every frame

jobs.description: seen from behind, his back and cloak to the viewer in every frame, a heavy two-handed hooking cut at an enemy in front of him away from the viewer towards the upper right: from his low guard he heaves the falx back and up over his right shoulder with both hands on the haft, steps forward onto his left foot with the hips turning first, and brings the curved sickle blade down hard in a diagonal arc from above his right shoulder into the enemy ahead of him, the inner edge leading, ending low at his left with the body bent forward in the follow-through, then he settles back into his low guard with the blade forward; both hands on the haft the whole time; the curved blade keeps its own shape and size in every frame, its point turned in at the tip like a sickle; his body keeps facing the upper right the whole time, he never turns round to the viewer; one falx only; no smear, no sparks, no motion trails, no blood, no effects
jobs.verdict: Promoted after frame drops: crescent smear f7 dropped, the windup peak f6 straight into the blow f8 (index 6); the follow-through f8-f12 turns side-on as a1 did; the hook reads in every frame

jobs.description: a heavy, weighted melee blow at an enemy close in front of him towards the viewer's lower right: he wraps the sling's cords round his right fist, draws the loaded pouch far back and up behind his right shoulder with his weight on his back foot, then lunges forward onto his left foot and brings the pouch down overhand in a hard arc onto the enemy's head in front of him like a club, his hips and shoulders turning into the blow and his whole body following through, bent forward over it, then he steps back and stands upright with the sling hanging from his right hand; he keeps facing the viewer's lower right in every frame; one sling only; no shield, no sparks, no blood, no effects
jobs.verdict: Rejected: a second man (the enemy) is drawn at the lower right and knocked down; the windup f3-f6 is good

jobs.description: seen from behind, his back and cloak to the viewer in every frame, a heavy, weighted melee blow at an enemy close in front of him towards the upper right: he wraps the sling's cords round his right fist, draws the loaded pouch far back and up over his right shoulder with his weight on his back foot, then lunges forward onto his left foot towards the upper right and brings the pouch down overhand in a hard arc straight ahead of him onto the enemy's head like a club, his hips and shoulders turning into the blow and his whole body following through, bent forward over it, then he steps back and stands upright with the sling hanging from his right hand; his body keeps facing the upper right the whole time, he never turns sideways or round to the viewer; one sling only; no shield, no sparks, no blood, no effects
jobs.verdict: Rejected: he turns to the viewer in the windup (f3-f4), the blow still goes up over his head, the sling vanishes f7-f9; a2 kept

jobs.description: seen from behind, his back to the viewer in every frame, a heavy, weighted melee blow at an enemy close in front of him towards the upper right: he grips the one bow with both hands like a staff, pulls it back to his chest with his weight on his back foot, then lunges forward onto his left foot towards the upper right and rams the end of the bow straight ahead of him level into the enemy's face, his hips and shoulders driving forward behind it and his whole body following through, then he pulls it back and steps back to stand upright with the bow in his left hand; the bow thrusts straight forward, not upward; his body keeps facing the upper right the whole time, he never turns sideways or round to the viewer; one bow only, a single curved limb; no second bow, no sparks, no blood, no effects
jobs.verdict: Promoted: draws the bow back to his chest and lunges, driving it forward with both hands and the whole body (f4-f7); a small spark f4 (cut); f2-f3 a little side-on. a1 swung the bow up with a blood burst

jobs.description: seen from behind, his back to the viewer in every frame, he takes his fighting guard in place: he brings the tall oval shield up in front of his body on his left arm, on the viewer's left, and raises the war axe in his right hand on the viewer's right, his right elbow bent and the fist at shoulder height out at his right side, the axe haft upright and the axe head up above his right shoulder, clear of the shield and away from it, ready to chop towards the upper left; the axe stays in his right hand on his right side in every frame, it never crosses over the shield; knees bent, the left foot a little forward; he keeps facing away towards the upper left, he does not turn round; one axe and one shield only, the shield stays on his left arm in every frame; no effects
jobs.verdict: Promoted (f7 the new NW guard): the axe raised in his right hand on the viewer's right, clear of the shield (a1 held it across over the shield's top edge); the axe head drawn a little bigger than the base's

jobs.description: seen from behind, his back and cloak to the viewer in every frame, braces to hold the line in place: he drops into a low wide crouch with the left foot forward and the right foot braced back, both hands firm on the haft, the curved falx blade set low and held forward towards the upper right like a hook against a charge; then holds the braced crouch, breathing; the falx keeps its shape in every frame: the curved iron blade with its point turned in at the tip like a sickle; he keeps facing away towards the upper right, he does not turn round; one falx only, both hands on the haft in every frame; no shield, no effects
jobs.verdict: Promoted: a low braced crouch, the hooked blade set forward in every frame

jobs.description: seen from behind, his back to the viewer in every frame, standing in place in a tense fighting stance behind his shield, knees bent, the weight shifting slowly from foot to foot, breathing; the tall oval shield stays up on his left arm on the viewer's left and the war axe stays raised in his right hand on the viewer's right, the axe head up above his right shoulder, clear of the shield, in every frame; he keeps facing away towards the upper left, he does not turn round; one axe and one shield only; no effects
jobs.verdict: Promoted: the axe raised on his right, the shield on his left, in every frame

jobs.description: seen from behind, his back to the viewer in every frame, charging forward at a heavy run in place away from the viewer towards the upper left, leaning into it, knees driving, the tall oval shield held up in front of him on his left arm on the viewer's left and the war axe raised in his right hand on the viewer's right, clear of the shield, clearly visible in every frame; he never turns round; one axe and one shield only, the shield stays on his left arm in every frame; no effects
jobs.verdict: Promoted: the axe raised on his right, clear of the shield; the shield face drawn a lighter brown in f1-f3, f8-f9 (kept)

jobs.description: he alone, no other person in the frame: a heavy, weighted melee blow at the empty air in front of him towards the viewer's lower right, as if at an enemy's head: he wraps the sling's cords round his right fist, draws the loaded pouch far back and up behind his right shoulder with his weight on his back foot, then lunges forward onto his left foot and brings the pouch down overhand in a hard arc ahead of him like a club, his hips and shoulders turning into the blow and his whole body following through, bent forward over it, then he steps back and stands upright with the sling hanging from his right hand; he keeps facing the viewer's lower right in every frame; only him, no enemy drawn; one sling only; no shield, no sparks, no blood, no effects
jobs.verdict: Promoted after frame drops: f0 (a red flash at the hand) and f4 (a crescent smear) dropped; he crouches (f1), rears up with the pouch high behind his shoulder (f2-f3, held), and lunges in bent low over the blow (f5, index 4) before recovering; sparks cut. a1 was a low swing from the rest

jobs.description: seen from behind, his back and cloak to the viewer in every frame, parries a heavy blow in place: he snaps the falx up with both hands on the haft and holds it across in front of his head and chest to catch the blow on the wooden haft, the impact jolts him back half a step, then he lowers it back to his guard with the curved blade held forward towards the upper right; the falx keeps its shape in every frame: the curved iron blade with its point turned in at the tip like a sickle; both hands on the haft in every frame; he keeps facing away towards the upper right, he does not turn round; one falx only; no shield, no sparks, no effects
jobs.verdict: Promoted: the a1 parry with the hooked blade; spark bursts f3-f4 (cut)

jobs.description: seen from behind, his back to the viewer in every frame, braces for a shield wall in place: he drops into a low crouch with the left foot forward and the right foot braced back, sets the tall oval shield forward in front of his body on his left arm on the viewer's left and leans his shoulder into it, the war axe held ready in his right hand on the viewer's right, raised beside his right shoulder, clear of the shield; then holds the braced crouch, breathing; he keeps facing away towards the upper left, he does not turn round; one shield on the left arm in every frame; one axe; no effects
jobs.verdict: Promoted: a braced crouch behind the shield, the axe raised on his right (a1 also, but from the old guard: kept for continuity with the new ready)

jobs.description: seen from behind, his back and cloak to the viewer in every frame, struck hard and knocked back: he reels backwards towards the viewer with two heavy stumbling steps, the head snapping back and the arms jolted, nearly losing his balance, then plants his feet and steps forward back into his low guard; both hands stay on the haft and the curved falx blade stays held forward towards the upper right in every frame; the falx keeps its shape in every frame: the curved iron blade with its point turned in at the tip like a sickle; he never turns round; one falx only; no motion blur, no blood, no effects; no shield
jobs.verdict: Promoted: reels back towards the viewer and steps back into the new guard, no blood (a1 had a blood burst f1); the falx swings back over his shoulder in the stagger, hook shape kept

jobs.description: seen from behind, his back to the viewer in every frame, takes cover in place: he crouches a little and pulls the tall oval shield on his left arm, on the viewer's left, up higher in front of his body until its rim is at his eyes, braces behind it with his shoulder for a moment, then lowers it back to his guard; the war axe stays raised in his right hand on the viewer's right, clear of the shield, in every frame; he never turns round; one axe and one shield only; no sparks, no effects
jobs.verdict: Promoted: the shield pulled up on his left, the axe stays raised on his right; small spark bits f2-f4 and f8 (cut)

jobs.description: he alone, no other person in the frame; seen from behind, his back and cloak to the viewer in every frame: a heavy, weighted melee blow straight ahead of him towards the upper right: he wraps the sling's cords round his right fist, coils back with his weight on his back foot and the loaded pouch drawn back low behind his right hip, then steps hard forward onto his left foot towards the upper right and whips the pouch round level at head height in a short flat hooking swing from his right to his left in front of him, his hips and shoulders turning through the blow and his body leaning into it, then he steps back and stands upright with the sling hanging from his right hand; his back stays to the viewer the whole time, he never turns sideways or round to the viewer; one sling only, it never leaves his hand; no shield, no sparks, no blood, no effects
jobs.verdict: Rejected: he turns towards the viewer in the windup (f1-f3) and to profile after the blow (f6-f8), a blood burst f5; not better than a2, which is kept

jobs.description: seen from behind, his back to the viewer in every frame, struck hard on the shield and knocked back: he reels backwards towards the viewer with two heavy stumbling steps, the head snapping back and the shield arm jolted, nearly losing his balance, then plants his feet and steps forward back into his guard; the tall oval shield stays on his left arm on the viewer's left and the war axe stays raised in his right hand on the viewer's right, clear of the shield, in every frame; he never turns round; one axe and one shield only; no motion blur, no blood, no effects
jobs.verdict: Promoted after a frame drop: f2 REJECTED (a blood burst over the shield), f1 held; the axe stays raised on his right

jobs.description: seen from behind, his back to the viewer in every frame, a heavy one-handed chopping blow at an enemy ahead of him towards the upper left: from his guard he lifts the war axe in his right hand straight up high over his right shoulder, on the viewer's right, without turning, then steps forward onto his left foot towards the upper left with the hips and shoulders turning, driving the tall shield forward with his body, and brings the axe down hard in a diagonal chop into the enemy ahead of him, the axe blade leading, ending low ahead of his left knee, then he recovers back into his guard behind the shield with the axe raised on his right; his body keeps facing the upper left the whole time, he never turns round or sideways to the viewer; the shield stays on his left arm; one axe only, the axe keeps its shape and size; no smear, no sparks, no motion trails, no blood, no effects
jobs.verdict: Promoted after frame drops: crescent smear f5 and smear + blood f6 dropped, the raised axe f4 held into the chop f7 (index 6); he keeps his back to the viewer the whole time (a1 turned round f2-f3)
